text: The safety investigation showed that the flight was under time pressure because of duty time limits for the crew. Fog was rolling in and visibility was near or below the minimum for legal takeoff. If they didn't take off soon, they would have to return to the gate and delay the flight for another day, so the captain decided to take off immediately. Why did the captain decide to take off in poor conditions?
